faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual salary from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work per week, then by 52. For a standard full-time week of 38 hours, the formula is: hourly rate × 38 × 52. For example, $50 per hour gives $50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800 per year. This assumes no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances.

faqs.q: Is casual loading included in my software engineer salary?

bodyMarkdown:
## Software Engineer Salary Australia: Understanding the Numbers

Whether you are negotiating a new role or checking your current pay, knowing how to convert an hourly rate to an annual salary is essential. This guide explains the key figures for a **software engineer salary Australia**, using the latest Fair Work Commission and Australian Bureau of Statistics data. We cover the National Minimum Wage, award rates, casual loading, superannuation, and tax – all in Australian English.

### The Basic Conversion: Hourly × Hours × 52

The standard formula for annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

We assume a full-time week of 38 hours, as defined by the Fair Work Act. For example, if you earn $50 per hour, your annual salary before tax and super is:

$50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800

If you are paid fortnightly, your gross pay is weekly pay × 2. A $50 hourly rate gives $1,900 per week, so $3,800 per fortnight.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage (NMW) from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 for a 38-hour week. This is the legal floor for award/agreement-free employees. However, most software engineers are covered by the **Professional Employees Award 2020** or a registered enterprise agreement. Award rates are higher than the NMW and vary by classification level. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) for each award, including the Professional Employees Award. Always check the correct award rate for your role.

### Casual Loading

If you are a casual employee, you are entitled to a 25% casual loading on top of the base hourly rate. For the NMW, that means $33.05 per hour ($26.44 × 1.25). For award-covered casuals, the loading is also 25% unless the award specifies a different amount. Our [timesheet](/) includes a checkbox to add casual loading automatically. Never enter a rate that already includes casual loading.

### Average Software Engineer Salary in Australia

While specific software engineer salary surveys vary, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Average Weekly Earnings report (May 2026) shows full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week. For a 38-hour week, that equates to approximately $54.83 per hour and $108,352 per year. This is a broad benchmark across all occupations, but software engineers typically earn above this average, especially in senior roles or in tech hubs like Sydney and Melbourne. For more detailed data, see our [reference tables](/data).

### Superannuation (Super) Paid on Top

Employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions of 12% of ordinary earnings on top of your salary. For 2026–27, the maximum contribution base is $270,830. If your annual salary is $100,000, your employer pays an extra $12,000 into your super fund. This is not deducted from your pay – it is an additional cost to the employer. Our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page explains how salary packaging can affect your take-home pay.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

For the 2026–27 financial year, the resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15c for each $1 over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: $4,020 plus 30c for each $1 over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: $31,020 plus 37c for each $1 over $135,000
- $190,001 and over: $51,370 plus 45c for each $1 over $190,000

Plus a Medicare levy of 2% (with reductions for low-income earners). The tax-free threshold of $18,200 means the first $18,200 of your income is untaxed. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool to estimate your net income after tax and Medicare.

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

If you are paid fortnightly, divide your annual salary by 26. For a $98,800 annual salary, that is $3,800 per fortnight before tax. After tax and Medicare, your take-home pay will be lower. The [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page helps you switch between hourly, weekly, fortnightly, and annual figures.

### Important Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

### Summary

Understanding your **software engineer salary Australia** starts with knowing your base hourly rate and whether you are award-covered or award-free. Use the Fair Work Ombudsman’s [pay guides](/blog) to confirm your minimum entitlements, and check the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page for the latest NMW. Always remember that super is paid on top, and tax is calculated on your gross income. For a quick estimate, use our [timesheet](/) to convert your hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures.
